21.name: FTP brute-force (hydra)
21.impact: FTP account lockout policy may lock users; audit log records every attempt.

22.name: SSH brute-force (hydra) — recommended
22.impact: SSH server logs every attempt; Fail2Ban / DenyHosts may block your IP.

22.name: SSH brute-force (ncrack) — alternative
22.impact: Same as hydra — faster but equally noisy.

23.name: Telnet brute-force (hydra)
23.impact: Telnet is plaintext; all authentication attempts logged in syslog.

25.name: SMTP command & user enumeration (nmap NSE)
25.impact: Low impact — queries SMTP server capabilities and user list.

80.name: HTTP vulnerability scan (nmap NSE)
80.impact: Some NSE scripts (http-shellshock) may crash the HTTP service.

80.name: HTTP form brute-force (hydra)
80.impact: WAF / ModSecurity may block your IP; access log volume spikes.

135.name: MSRPC endpoint enumeration (nmap NSE)
135.impact: Low impact — queries RPC endpoint mapper.

139.name: NetBIOS OS and share enumeration (nmap NSE)

443.name: HTTPS vulnerability + SSL scan (nmap NSE)
443.impact: SSL scripts are safe; HTTP vuln scripts may crash the service.

443.name: HTTPS form brute-force (hydra)
443.impact: Cloudflare / WAF / rate-limit may block your IP.

445.name: SMB vulnerability scan (EternalBlue, etc.)
445.impact: CRITICAL: smb-vuln-ms17-010 may cause SMB server BSOD / crash.

445.name: SMB OS, shares & users enumeration (nmap NSE)
445.impact: Low impact — Windows Event IDs 5140, 5145 generated.

445.name: SMB brute-force (hydra) — recommended
445.impact: CRITICAL: Account lockout policy may lock domain users.

445.name: SMB brute-force (ncrack) — alternative
445.impact: Security Event ID 4625 volume may trigger EDR alerts.

1433.name: MSSQL brute-force (hydra)
1433.impact: SQL Server Error Log fills with login failed entries.

3306.name: MySQL brute-force (hydra)
3306.impact: MySQL general log volume increases; may cause temporary DB latency.

3389.name: RDP brute-force (hydra) — stable, recommended
3389.impact: CRITICAL: Account lockout policy may lock domain users entirely.

3389.name: RDP brute-force (ncrack) — faster alternative
3389.impact: Same account lockout risk; high Event ID 4625 volume.

5432.name: PostgreSQL brute-force (hydra)
5432.impact: PostgreSQL log contains failed auth entries.

5900.name: VNC brute-force (hydra) on port 5900
5900.impact: VNC server may lag under repeated auth attempts.

5985.name: WinRM brute-force (hydra)
5985.impact: Windows Security Event ID 4625 volume spikes; account lockout risk.

5985.name: WinRM shell via evil-winrm (requires credential first)
5985.impact: Active WinRM session — Event IDs 4648 (logon) and 4672 (admin) are generated.

5986.name: WinRM HTTPS brute-force (hydra)
5986.impact: Same as 5985 — Security Event ID 4625 volume.

5986.name: WinRM HTTPS shell via evil-winrm (requires credential first)
5986.impact: WinRM over SSL — log footprint identical to 5985.

6379.name: Redis brute-force (hydra)
6379.impact: Redis log grows; potential latency increase.

8080.name: HTTP (8080) form brute-force (hydra)
8080.impact: Reverse proxy or WAF may block your IP.
